grain: one display-ad impression row transformed into one attribution touchpoint
source_period: Criteo 30-day live traffic sample; repo sample uses day_int=1 shard part-00238
sample_filter: users with at least two impressions in the downloaded shard
channel_definition: channel is an anonymized publisher placement group. Top eight publishers by touch volume are mapped to Publisher 01-08; the rest are grouped as Long-tail placements.
date_handling: CriteoPrivateAd partitions by relative day_int, not real calendar dates. The repo maps day_int=1 to 2025-01-01 as a relative plotting date.
value_assumption: Revenue is modeled as sales_count * $120 assumed contribution per sale because source data provides sales counts but not advertiser revenue.
